name: Global POS
platforms: Android · iPhone/iPad · Desktop — installable web app (PWA)
description: Every store. One platform. Discover registered stores by location or address and browse inventory linked to each store's address. Manage tenants, stores, staff and inventory through Global POS administration.
features: Nearest registered store with optional location permission
Manual store selection through address search
Store-specific inventory with automatic address and coordinate tags
Super admin, tenant and store controls with scoped staff roles
Isolated super admin demo with sample Lagos and Texas stores
Android, iPhone/iPad and desktop web installation
Searchable multi-store marketplace with one-store baskets
Server-calculated order totals and configured hosted payment gateways
Scoped, expiring integration API keys with rotation and revocation
limitations: Pre-launch preview. Internet required. Live payments are disabled by default and require merchant credentials and operator setup. Demo payments are simulated. Camera scanning, exit-verification receipts, automatic refunds and background payment reconciliation are pending. No native APK or app-store release. Operator contact and retention settings remain pending.
